correctness.rationale: For every z>0, cycle maximality is equivalent to avoidance of 11 and 000. The primitive 3x3 transfer matrix gives cubic λ³-zλ-z and a unique positive λ. The 2/3-gap renewal law gives a noncancelling rational generating function for occupancy covariances. Discriminant z²(4z-27), explicit non-Perron root ratios, and monotonicity yield unique ξ minimum 1/log2; at criticality the double pole gives C(r)=4(3r+5)(-1/2)^r/81 for all r>=0. Included checker verified exact ring partitions N=3..14, critical correlations r=0..80, algebraic identities and endpoint diagnostics. No finite test is used as the universal proof.

value.rationale: The new exact threshold, strictly minimal decay length, incommensurate-to-alternating mode change, defective eigenvalue, critical all-separation polynomial prefactor, and contrasting low/high activity length exponents jointly provide a meaningful physical characterization of competition between period-three and period-two ordered states in a natural model.
